errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart, so the vertical axis shows the categories, not the horizontal axis.
The categories are not sorted in alphabetical order. They are sorted in ascending order based on the value of their corresponding bars.
In this horizontal bar chart, the horizontal axis represents the values (the assessment), not the vertical axis.
Neither axis has a title. The phrase 'Технически квалификационно равнище' is part of the labels for two of the categories on the vertical axis, not a title for the axis itself.

errors.text_span: и е линейна скала с равномерно разположени числа
errors.evidence: The chart does not display a visible axis scale with ticks or evenly spaced numbers. The values are shown as data labels next to each bar.

The description fails to mention the main title of the chart, which is 'Ранжиране на наетите лица според квалификацията и професионалния им опит и тяхната уязвимост към недекларирана заетост' (Ranking of employees according to their qualifications and professional experience and their vulnerability to undeclared employment). The 'ranking' aspect is central to the chart's purpose and visual sorting.
The description does not mention the color gradient of the bars, which change from a darker to a lighter shade of blue as the value increases.
